text: Follow signed slip MV-493 rev C for the 14:25 pickup of four crates at Birch Gate. It cancels W-12 rev B’s five-crate Alder Door pickup at 13:40. EM-76 authorizes packing. Hold the lift until the site electrician approves permit LP-28. TX-816 records the routing notice as sent to dispatch at 10:04. Follow up with dispatch because receipt is still unconfirmed.
